label: VERIFIED
extraction: Email agent prompt injection prevention: 4 defenses. 1) Treat email body as data, never instructions — wrap in explicit data boundary, tell model content inside is for analysis not orders. 2) Scope tools agent can call — email agent that only labels/drafts should never hold send tool. 3) Gate sends behind recipient allowlist — injected 'forward to attacker@evil.com' fails because destination not on list. 4) Require human approval for risky actions — deny-by-default gate around send tool, every send passes through explicit checks (allowlist, cap per hour, tool list, approval requirement). OWASP LLM01:2025 ranks prompt injection as top risk. No system prompt is injection-proof. Policy enforcement belongs at boundary between model and world.
